subject: never did connect
author: twalker3292
body: The first night(april 30) I got kicked off about 4 times, server issue apparently. Then last night (April !st) it wouldnt let me on at all, everytime I tried it would say it couldnt connect to servers. They should really fix this, maybe it will be up tonight.

subject: Could finally connect
author: Xandu
body:
I was able to reconnect to the servers around midnight. Played some Cops and Robbers with Kev, Suf and hn6. I think it was lots of fun. Since the cars are so slow the chases gets really close and in one way it almost feels like Burnout 3 Takedown only much slower. I guess they had to remove boost and slow down the cars to make the game mode work. The city is probably to small to be playing this game mode in full speed as it would only take about 30 secs to deliver the gold.

-- The Creator --
